text: As BugClan's leader gives their speech during the Gathering, Yewstar bellows with laughter at one of their jokes. Only... it wasn't a joke, apparently. Yewstar apologizes profusely, but the damage is already done. (BugClan relations worsened.)

When RiverClan finds Malia, she looks wary of so many sleek, muscled cats surrounding her. Still, Malia listens carefully as RiverClan explains that all this strength could help protect her. She would no longer be alone against the world. Malia tentatively agrees.
Yewstar learns a helpful skill from Murkhaven. (medium positive effect)
Yewstar discusses plans to expand the territory with Primfreckle. (medium positive effect)
Yewstar spent too long out in the sun. He's gotten heat exhaustion.
Prancelaurel has healed from all her scrapes.
When Heatherfern gets sick for a few days, Prancelaurel brings her fresh-kill and bedding. (high positive effect)
Prancelaurel, Quailfur, Saffronfoot, Carptail, and Riomane hang out while stretching. (positive effect)
Oddmuzzle tripped Prancelaurel. Prancelaurel doubts it was an accident. (medium negative effect)
Craneflight compliments Auburnsplash on her bravery today. (medium positive effect)
Craneflight learns something new about a Clanmate from Pebblefur. (low positive effect)
Craneflight considers, as she looks out over the Clan, if perhaps this isn't where she belongs.
Talonlake promises Primfreckle that everything will be okay. (medium positive effect)
Primfreckle doesn't understand why Oddmuzzle is being so rude. (low negative effect)
Peatcrest spent a long time talking with Erminedaisy but was disappointed by Erminedaisy's lack of interest. (high negative effect)
Peatcrest worries that one of his friends prefers Primfreckle. (medium negative effect)
Carptail and Saltpaw invent a new treatment method together. (medium positive effect)
Carptail warns Auburnsplash, Stoatshade, Diablofoot, and Cobaltstrike about a plant they were discussing and teaches them about its dangers. (positive effect)
Carptail was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Yewstar last night... (high positive effect)
Saffronfoot is impressed by some of Snakepaw's advice. (medium positive effect)
Saffronfoot confesses to Suntooth that he has feelings for Freezefoot. (positive effect)
When Saffronfoot tells Oddmuzzle about a goal he has, Oddmuzzle snickers at it. (low negative effect)
Oddmuzzle can't help but admire Talonlake's pelt. (low positive effect)
Oddmuzzle, Murkhaven, and Pebblechase took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Oddmuzzle is impressed with Algaepool's willingness to help. (medium positive effect)
Hollyheart is prancing around in front of Heavythud. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart gets some good advice from Fringesnap about something trivial. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart missed a tick while grooming, and is now suffering the consequences. She has tick fever.
Heavythud learns something new about a Clanmate from Shimmerpaw. (low positive effect)
Heavythud swears he sees Skulkwillow sneaking around the camp at night. (medium negative effect)
Heavythud picked out the best piece of prey to share with Frondpad. (medium positive effect)
Shimmerpaw and Skulkwillow debate about something interesting. Though they disagree, they stay amicable. (medium positive effect)
Shimmerpaw promises to always look out for Hailpaw. (high positive effect)
Shimmerpaw is sick with tick fever.
Cobaltstrike brought Flutterpaw some dry bedding. (low positive effect)
Flutterpaw realizes that Onepaw's been avoiding him. (medium negative effect)
Flutterpaw was seen playing with a kittypet over the border. The Clan has encountered Azizi.
Saltpaw thinks he can tell Pigeonbloom something important. (high positive effect)
Snakepaw snitches on Saltpaw for something minor. (low negative effect)
Pebblefur's heat exhaustion has abated.
Pebblefur is impressed with Skippaw's willingness to help. (medium positive effect)
Pebblefur has noticed tensions in the Clan, so she organizes time for Duckbelly, Tomatofreckle, Curryfoot, and Craneflight to relax and have others to talk to. (positive effect)
Pebblefur and Olivebranch share stories of a Clanmate they didn't realize they both miss. (medium positive effect)
Pebblefur spent too long out in the sun. She's gotten heat stroke.
Pebblefur is suddenly struck by a sharp pain in her chest. She is found later that day, cold.
Olivebranch tells Cobaltstrike something interesting about another Clan. (medium positive effect)
Olivebranch, Elmtrail, and Malia had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Olivebranch tells Erminedaisy to talk a little quieter. (low negative effect)
Burrweb lets Duckbelly know that a Clanmate was talking badly about him. (low positive effect)
Erminedaisy mentions that Duckbelly looks good today. (low positive effect)
Duckbelly has been yowling about his ticks for the better part of the day, the itchy bites maddening to him.
Curryfoot and Erminedaisy agree with each other when no one else does. (high positive effect)
Curryfoot and Kamautail find out they're both bringing flowers to the same Clanmate's grave. (high positive effect)
Tomatofreckle is wowed by how bravely Mallowpaw fought the other day. (high positive effect)
Stretching might be good for one's health, but Olivebranch, Duckbelly, Curryfoot, and Craneflight wish Tomatofreckle didn't insist on stretching at the crack of dawn. (negative effect)
Tomatofreckle just barely missed a mouse, but Riomane caught it right after, handing it off to her. (medium positive effect)
Frondpad motivates Kamautail to do something difficult. (medium positive effect)
Early in the morning, Kamautail rallies Volepaw, Prancelaurel, Suntooth, and Curryfoot to do stretches in hopes of keeping his Clanmates prepared for anything. (negative effect)
While looking at the stars, Kamautail and Erminedaisy make up some constellations. (high positive effect)
Stoatshade talks to Amberfur about a mutual friend they have both been worrying about. (high positive effect)
Stoatshade wishes Bitterleaf would lose interest in Dancingscreech. (negative effect)
Stoatshade asks Quailfur how he's doing. (low positive effect)
Ochretail and Carptail chat about Clan news. (low positive effect)
Ochretail and Paellapad find out they're both bringing flowers to the same Clanmate's grave. (high positive effect)
The Clan notices that Algaepool and Fidgetmouse always sit far away from one another. (medium negative effect)
Algaepool rallies Heavythud, Gracklefur, Suntooth, and Dancingpaw to do early morning stretches with him. (negative effect)
Algaepool is talking with Auburnsplash. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart rolled her eyes after Auburnsplash asked for help. (low negative effect)
Harefeather brought Auburnsplash some dry bedding. (low positive effect)
Erminedaisy has recovered from his sprain.
Erminedaisy can't believe how talented Petalglow is! (high positive effect)
Erminedaisy gets some good advice from Ochretail about something trivial. (low positive effect)
Bushberry bickers with Onepaw over who gets what nest material. (low negative effect)
Dancingpaw, Mallowpaw, Volepaw, and Shimmerpaw are too busy goofing off to listen to Bushberry's advice. (negative effect)
Bushberry heard a story about something kind Pebblechase did. (low positive effect)
Pebblechase and Pheasantbrush swap secrets with each other. (high positive effect)
Pebblechase, Bitterleaf, and Bitebone took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Pebblechase greets Paellapad as she's exiting the warriors' den. (medium positive effect)
Heatherfern quickly apologizes after bumping into Pheasantbrush. They have a small laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Stretching might be good for one's health, but Cobaltstrike, Paellapad, Pebblechase, and Fidgetmouse wish Heatherfern didn't insist on stretching at the crack of dawn. (negative effect)
Heatherfern finds a bit of fluff that smells like Kamautail and adds it to her nest. (low positive effect)
Riomane was flattered by Auburnsplash's politeness this morning. (low positive effect)
During a conversation with Paellapad, Riomane says something too bluntly. (high negative effect)
Fidgetmouse noticed that Volepaw is falling behind in training and offered to help her catch up. (medium positive effect)
Fidgetmouse can't help but feel uneased at Malia's words lately. (low negative effect)
Archbellow got stuck in the same tree with Harefeather for hours and realized how much they have in common. (high positive effect)
Archbellow, Kamautail, and Paellapad had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Some of Archbellow's favorite memories are with Algaepool. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow draws a pretty symbol in the sand that Cobaltstrike makes sure not to mess up. (low positive effect)
Cobaltstrike overhears something about Prancelaurel that he can relate to. (medium positive effect)
When tucking in for the night, Pigeonbloom saw that Paellapad fixed their nest. (low positive effect)

Pigeonbloom, Pebblechase, and Burrweb decide they're going to get Bitebone and Primfreckle together. They talk about how much Bitebone loves Primfreckle in front of Primfreckle, and, to their pleasure, find the two talking later. (positive effect)
Bitterleaf calls out the Clan for targeting Pigeonbloom. (high positive effect)
Bitterleaf keeps getting on Talonlake for a bad habit, and it's putting a rift between them. (high negative effect)
Bitterleaf, wanting to help keep his Clanmates in shape and ready for anything, wakes Pheasantbrush, Pigeonbloom, Cobaltstrike, and Harefeather up early for morning stretches. (negative effect)
Harefeather had a spat with Gardeniaglow over a piece of prey on the fresh-kill pile. (medium negative effect)
Before a den comes caving in, Harefeather forces Volepaw, Flightpaw, Dancingpaw, and Rollpaw to help him with maintenance. (negative effect)
Harefeather includes Gracklefur in a conversation that Gracklefur struggled to join. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart snickered when Paellapad tripped. (low negative effect)
Volepaw is the only one who gets Dancingscreech's joke. (medium positive effect)
Dancingscreech notices that Auburnsplash is fixing a damaged part of the camp without being asked. (low positive effect)
Fluttershade was being condescending towards Dancingpaw all day long. (low negative effect)
Fluttershade is talking with Bouncepelt. (low positive effect)
Fluttershade purrs for a long time at one of Prancelaurel's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Gracklefur finds out something small about Pigeonbloom that Pigeonbloom had lied about before. (low negative effect)
Stoatshade asks Gracklefur to stop following him around. (medium negative effect)
Peakspore had a difficult conversation with Saltpaw, and they both ended up resentful of one another. (high negative effect)
Peakspore has been spending time with Bouncepelt lately. (low positive effect)
Ochretail helps Bitebone hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Bitebone, Pearpelt, and Suntooth had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Bitebone appreciates Fluttershade's helpful attitude. (low positive effect)
Bouncepelt just told Fidgetmouse a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Bouncepelt rallies Harefeather, Cobaltstrike, Stoatshade, and Diablofoot to do early morning stretches with him. (negative effect)
Burrweb realizes how hard it is to hold a conversation with Tomatofreckle. (medium negative effect)
Burrweb and Freezefoot bring each other prey. (medium positive effect)
Suntooth often goes to Diablofoot for guidance. (high positive effect)
Pearpelt is impressed by some of Stoatshade's advice. (medium positive effect)
Pearpelt and Quailfur swap secrets with each other. (high positive effect)
Quailfur has noticed Yewstar isn't doing a lot of work lately. (medium negative effect)
Quailfur, wanting to help keep his Clanmates in shape and ready for anything, wakes Snakepaw, Dancingpaw, Poolpaw, and Algaepool up early for morning stretches. (negative effect)
Quailfur has gotten fleas.
Both Diablofoot and Gracklefur enthusiastically congratulate another Clanmate on something. (medium positive effect)
Freezefoot said something the other day that made Diablofoot nervous. (medium negative effect)
Ochretail doesn't believe Reedheart when he explains that a rumor about him is false. (high negative effect)
Stretching might be good for one's health, but Diablofoot, Freezefoot, Fluttershade, and Primfreckle wish Reedheart didn't insist on stretching at the crack of dawn. (negative effect)
The Clan likes one of Auburnsplash's suggestions, but it was just Reedheart's reworded. (medium negative effect)
Reedheart purrs for a long time at one of Pearpelt's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Murkhaven lets Freezefoot know that a Clanmate was talking badly about her. (low positive effect)
Malia won't tell Snippool what she finds so funny. (medium negative effect)
Snippool has been spending time with Brindletooth lately. (low positive effect)
Snippool purrs for a long time at one of Murkhaven's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow is glad to have a Clanmate like Burrweb. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow backs up one of Mossflight's claims during one of Mossflight's arguments. (high positive effect)
Volepaw compliments Mossflight's name. (low positive effect)
Mossflight attempts to keep Snakepaw, Onepaw, Skippaw, and Flightpaw focused during training, but the four continuously talk about unrelated topics. (negative effect)
Mossflight is letting Hushshimmer share their troubles with her, hoping they'll feel better afterward. (high positive effect)
Hushshimmer and Algaepool work together to lead a scary bug out of the camp. (low positive effect)
Hushshimmer's eagerness to do early morning stretches rubs off on Kokomi, Tomatofreckle, Shinefur, and Pigeonbloom. (positive effect)
Mossflight won't help Hushshimmer fix their nest. (low negative effect)
Volepaw lets Warmswirl grab a piece of fresh-kill first. (low positive effect)
Shardtail follows through on a small promise made with Warmswirl. (low positive effect)
Shardtail has recovered from heat stroke.
Shardtail is impressed by some of Cobaltstrike's advice. (medium positive effect)
Shardtail overhears Heavythud dispelling a false rumor about a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
Kokomi thinks about how Snippool is always reliable. (medium positive effect)
A Clanmate accuses Kokomi of copying one of Heavythud's jokes. (medium negative effect)
Amberfur snaps at Snakepaw to leave him alone. (high negative effect)
Amberfur scolds Verbenabloom for not telling anyone about a piece of crowfood in the pile. (high negative effect)
Algaepool lets Fringesnap grab a piece of fresh-kill first. (low positive effect)
Fringesnap remembers something nice that Amberfur did. (low positive effect)
Verbenabloom is prancing around in front of Shardtail. (low positive effect)
Verbenabloom, Diablofoot, and Bitterleaf had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Shinefur helps Verbenabloom hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Fleadusk is glad that his stomachache is finally gone.
Flutterpaw does something that makes Fleadusk's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
When tucking in for the night, Fleadusk saw that Kokomi fixed his nest. (low positive effect)
Pheasantbrush is talking to Skulkwillow, but he can't stop noticing the mud on Pheasantbrush's pelt. (low negative effect)
Skulkwillow, Murkhaven, and Sardinespeckle took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Skulkwillow and Hushshimmer cuddle during a storm. (medium positive effect)
Snippool is shocked to be told that she's pregnant. Surely it's not time to move into the nursery, though.
Hollyheart snitches on Murkhaven for something minor. (low negative effect)
Murkhaven chats with Skulkwillow about his day. (medium positive effect)
Icyriver is no longer suffering from tick fever.
Icyriver notices that Frondpad is always one of the first to volunteer for a difficult task. (medium positive effect)
Icyriver likes to sit near Verbenabloom during conversations. (low positive effect)
Elmtrail's small cut has healed up nicely.
After something unsettling happens, Elmtrail and Hollyheart find comfort in one another's company. (high positive effect)
Elmtrail, Duckbelly, and Fidgetmouse took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Elmtrail had a good dream about Poolpaw. (low positive effect)
Fluttershade says something vulnerable to Brindletooth. (low positive effect)
Icyriver gives advice to Brindletooth. It's not good advice, but Brindletooth appreciates the effort. (low positive effect)
Amberfur lets Sardinespeckle know that a Clanmate was talking badly about her. (low positive effect)
Fleadusk tells Sardinespeckle that he was worried about her. (low positive effect)
Shinefur is disappointed in Algaepool's lack of initiative. (medium negative effect)
Talonlake was noticeably distracted while Poolpaw was trying to tell a story. (high negative effect)
Talonlake has been spending time with Icyriver lately. (low positive effect)
Frondpad is disappointed when Gentlekit doesn't uphold a promise. (medium negative effect)
Frondpad regales Pebblechase, Olivebranch, Riomane, and Craneflight with stories about her latest fight. (positive effect)
Frondpad asks to be on a patrol with Fringesnap. (medium positive effect)
Pheasantbrush dreams about something that feels prophetic, and starts to act strange around Suntooth. (high negative effect)
Pheasantbrush pesters Dancingpaw, Hailpaw, Shimmerpaw, and Volepaw into helping her with repairs across camp. (negative effect)
Pheasantbrush notices how closely Shimmerpaw sticks to his beliefs. (medium positive effect)
Poolpaw and Warmswirl defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Poolpaw thinks the Clan's ancestors smile upon Pheasantbrush. (high positive effect)
Mallowpaw's small cut is no longer bothering him.
RiverClan welcomes Mallowpelt as a new warrior, honoring his prudence.
Mallowpelt thought Shardtail was polite today. (low positive effect)
Yewstar calls the Clan to a meeting and declares Onepaw to be a warrior. They are now called Onemuzzle and are celebrated for their determination.
Fluttershade gives Onemuzzle something that they dropped. (low positive effect)
Late into the evening, Onemuzzle invites Fluttershade, Harefeather, Hailpaw, and Pebblechase to stretch with them and enjoy each other's company. (positive effect)
Flightpaw keeps asking Onemuzzle if they trust him. (low negative effect)
Volepaw is jealous that Brindletooth got to fight in a border skirmish when she didn't. (medium negative effect)
Flightpaw spent a long time talking with Poolpaw but was disappointed by Poolpaw's lack of interest. (high negative effect)
Flightpaw, Carptail, and Shimmerpaw took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Skippaw and Fringesnap work well on a patrol together. (medium positive effect)
Skippaw thinks Saltpaw is a good singer. (low positive effect)
Hailpaw and Onemuzzle often look at each other and smile knowingly about something. (low positive effect)
Shimmerpaw sees a pretty flower in Dancingscreech's nest. (low positive effect)
Shimmerpaw and Flutterpaw make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
Rollpaw likes the way Fluttershade laughs. (medium positive effect)
When Dancingpaw gets a little hurt, Gardeniaglow giggles before asking if he's okay. (low negative effect)
Snakepaw doesn't like Algaepool's sense of humor. (medium negative effect)
Snakepaw finds a bit of fluff that smells like Rollpaw and adds it to his nest. (low positive effect)
Petalglow is having a wonderful time discussing recent Clan news with Dancingkit. (high positive effect)
Petalglow sees Tomatofreckle put something back where it belongs. (low positive effect)
Mosscrackle learns that Reedheart is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
Mosscrackle is disappointed when Craneflight doesn't uphold a promise. (medium negative effect)
Skulkwillow mentions that Gentlekit looks good today. (low positive effect)
Gentlekit and Dancingkit agree to be best friends forever. (high positive effect)
Dancingkit can't stand hearing about how helpful Pearpelt is. (high negative effect)
Dancingkit depends on Gentlekit to back her up during a debate. (high positive effect)
Malia didn't tell Auburnsplash about the feather stuck to her face, so Auburnsplash spent the whole day looking silly. (low negative effect)
Flightpaw, Volepaw, Poolpaw, and Snakepaw bemoan Malia's insistence that they get up and do stretches at dawn. While they do it, nobody but Malia likes it. (negative effect)
Malia tries to have a conversation with Bushberry but it ends up awkward when neither of them speak up. (low negative effect)
Olivebranch can't imagine going on living without Pebblefur.
Pigeonbloom can't help the way their voice cracks while recalling Pebblefur's life at the vigil. Even so, they force a smile, knowing Pebblefur would want a celebratory memorial.
Nobody can comfort Peatcrest during the vigil; he's absolutely inconsolable, convinced that he'll never feel normal again without Pebblefur beside him.
Curryfoot can't handle the vigil's entirety, despite her best efforts. Pebblefur's death has drained her. Curryfoot settles into her nest in a tight ball, hoping Pebblefur might visit in a dream.

This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in StarClan. c_n mourns the loss of their Clanmate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
